_comment: Allowlisted data sources. scripts/prepare_data.py only downloads URLs listed here. sha256 values are the checksums observed on first download (2026-11-15); a mismatch fails preparation loudly. DOIs were checked to resolve (curl -sIL https://doi.org/<doi>) on 2026-11-16.
